title: 花旗ECM联席主管：美国与中国仍是大型发行主力，印度英国也在升温
speaker: Unknown (Citi Global Co-Head of Equity Capital Markets)

segments.en: Where do you see the most activity? Is it still US and China and here in Hong Kong? I mean, I know India is quite exciting.
segments.zh: 您认为哪里活动最活跃？仍然是美国、中国和香港吗？我知道印度也相当令人兴奋。

segments.en: Yeah, I think the bulk of the activity will continue to be the US and China. That's where we expect large capital raises to happen for the most part.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为大部分活动仍将集中在美国和中国。我们预计大型资本募集主要仍将发生在这里。

segments.en: But it's been an interesting period over the last few weeks. We've talked about volatility in the US, but at the same time, there are two large IPOs.
segments.zh: 但过去几周是一段有趣的时期。我们谈到了美国的市场波动，但同时还有两宗大型IPO。

segments.en: NSC was done in India. GEO is launching today. The UK had its largest IPO in the last five years. Here in China, we've raised China and Taiwan.
segments.zh: NSC在印度完成。GEO今天启动。英国完成了过去五年最大IPO。在中国，我们为中国和台湾地区募集了资金。

segments.en: We've raised money for IPOs for companies in the AI ecosystem. UMC did a close to $2 billion a few weeks ago.
segments.zh: 我们为人工智能生态系统的公司进行了IPO募资。联电几周前完成了近20亿美元的发行。

segments.en: So activity still actually remains elevated when you think about long-term averages. It's been a slightly slower period in North America after an incredible run for the first nine months of the year.
segments.zh: 因此，从长期均值来看，活动实际上仍处于较高水平。北美在今年前九个月经历了一轮惊人行情后，近期略有放缓。

segments.en: Which I think, if you could differentiate also for us, because this is also coming at a time into your point. We don't get years like this every year.
segments.zh: 我认为，如果您也能为我们做个区分，因为正如您所说，这也是在一个特殊时点。我们并非每年都有这样的年份。

segments.en: This is almost once in a cycle, once in a couple of decades, once in a decade, that's put it that way.
segments.zh: 这几乎是每个周期才有一次，几十年一遇、十年一遇，可以这么说。
